top_signals.title: Malaysia Says May Intervene If AirAsia’s Financial Woes Worsen
top_signals.summary: Malaysia may consider stepping in to support AirAsia Group Bhd. if the airline’s financial difficulties worsen, Second Finance Minister Amir Hamzah Azizan said, as the government seeks to protect domestic air connectivity.

top_signals.title: Switzerland’s biggest bank set for showdown with lawmakers as capital fight intensifies amid crisis planning
top_signals.summary: Swiss regulator FINMA said UBS can execute its preferred crisis-resolution strategy, even as the bank faces a separate parliamentary fight over tougher capital requirements.

top_signals.title: Sky proposes emergency vote on $25M transfer amid liquidity stress
top_signals.summary: Sky’s Core Facilitator invoked the protocol’s emergency response process to expedite a vote rather than wait until the next scheduled vote on Dec. 3.
